build.beforeBuildCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
build.beforeDevCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build

bundle.shortDescription: GridFPV native desktop — embeds the Director, opens the RD console.
bundle.longDescription: GridFPV native desktop app. On launch it runs the GridFPV Director server in-process, bound to a loopback ephemeral port with a per-user data directory, then opens the RD console pointed at it. Loopback means the control path is open (no auth), per the GridFPV auth model. The hosted Director (gridfpv-app) remains the development path.
